```python
# ams_query.py
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re

items = [
    'dehydrated onions', 'dehydrated potatoes', 'dehydrated carrots', 'dehydrated beets',
    'dehydrated sweet corn', 'dehydrated green beans', 'dehydrated bell peppers', 'dehydrated okra',
    'dehydrated cabbage', 'dehydrated spinach', 'dehydrated tomatoes', 'prunes', 'raisins',
    'dried figs', 'dried dates', 'dehydrated celery', 'frozen onions', 'frozen potatoes',
    'frozen carrots', 'frozen beets', 'frozen sweet corn', 'frozen green beans', 'frozen bell peppers',
    'frozen okra', 'frozen cabbage', 'frozen spinach', 'frozen tomatoes', 'frozen celery'
]

base = 'https://www.ams.usda.gov/search?search_api_fulltext='

def find_latest_year(term):
    url = base + term.replace(' ','+') + '&f[0]=field_document_type%3Astandards'
    r = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, 'html.parser')
    years = []
    for sr in soup.select('div.search-result'):
        text = ' '.join([sr.get_text(' ', strip=True)]).lower()
        for y in re.findall(r'(19\d{2}|20\d{2})', text):
            years.append(int(y))
    return max(years) if years else None

results = {}
for it in items:
    try:
        yr = find_latest_year(it)
    except Exception:
        yr = None
    results[it] = yr

for k,v in results.items():
    print(k, '->', v)
```
